<style>
/* New Leaf: how the theme's own sections look in this template (header, counts, maker, newsletter, product information, product cards, footer). */
.section-stat-counter {
  .stat-counter-section { border-top: 1px solid rgba(28, 28, 26, .1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(28, 28, 26, .1); }
  .stat-counter__item { display: flex !important; flex-direction: row !important; align-items: center !important; justify-content: flex-start !important; gap: 14px !important; padding: 20px 0; text-align: left !important; }
  .stat-counter__value { flex: none; margin: 0 !important; font-family: var(--heading-font) !important; color: #2f5d50 !important; line-height: 1 !important; font-size: 46px !important; }
  .stat-counter__number, .stat-counter__suffix, .stat-counter__prefix { font-family: inherit !important; color: inherit !important; font-size: inherit !important; font-weight: 400 !important; }
  .stat-counter__label { margin: 0 !important; max-width: 220px; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--color-text); text-align: left; }
  @media (min-width: 750px) { .stat-counter__item { padding: 34px 0 !important; } .stat-counter__item + .stat-counter__item { padding-left: 24px; } }
  @media (max-width: 749px) { .stat-counter__value { font-size: 38px !important; } .stat-counter__item + .stat-counter__item { border-top: 1px solid rgba(28, 28, 26, .08); } .stat-counter { gap: 0 !important; } }
}
.section-sticky-heading-text {
  .sht { border-top: 1px solid rgba(28, 28, 26, .1); }
  .sht__heading { font-size: 30px; line-height: 1.15; max-width: 9em; }
  .sht__text { font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.75; max-width: 600px; }
  .sht__text a { color: var(--color-heading); text-underline-offset: 3px; }
  .sht__text p > strong:only-child { display: inline-block; margin-top: 2px; font-family: var(--heading-font); font-weight: 400; font-size: 21px; color: #2f5d50; }
  @media (max-width: 749px) { .sht__heading { font-size: 26px; } }
}
.section-r7n {
  .r7n__media { display: none !important; }
  .r7n__split { display: block !important; }
  .r7n__body { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 22px; max-width: none !important; padding: 28px 22px; border-radius: 14px; background: #ebeee9; }
  @media (min-width: 990px) { .r7n__body { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.05fr); gap: 48px; padding: 36px 40px; align-items: start; } }
  .r7n__header { margin: 0 !important; text-align: left; }
  .r7n__heading { font-size: 30px !important; line-height: 1.15; margin: 0 0 10px; }
  .r7n__subheading { font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--color-text); max-width: 40ch; }
  .r7n__signup { margin: 0 !important; max-width: none !important; }
  .r7n__fields > .r7n__vh { position: static !important; width: auto !important; height: auto !important; clip: auto !important; clip-path: none !important; overflow: visible !important; margin: 0 0 8px !important; flex: 0 0 100% !important; white-space: normal; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-heading); }
  .r7n__fields { flex-wrap: wrap !important; }
  .r7n__note, .r7n__note p { font-size: 12.5px !important; line-height: 1.55; }
  .r7n__note a { color: var(--color-heading); text-underline-offset: 2px; }
}
.main-product-section {
  @media (min-width: 990px) { .main-product { margin-inline: 0 !important; flex-direction: row-reverse !important; align-items: center !important; flex-wrap: nowrap !important; gap: 56px !important; } .product-detail__information { padding-top: 0 !important; } }
  @media (max-width: 989px) { .product-detail__media { order: 2; margin-top: 28px; } }
  .media-gallery__image:first-child:not(:only-child), .media-gallery__image:nth-child(n+3) { display: none !important; }
  .product-detail__media media-gallery { display: block; padding: 5% 4% 3%; border-radius: 16px; background: #efe7d6; }
  .media-gallery__image, .media-gallery__image .loading_image { background: transparent !important; border-radius: 0 !important; }
  .media-gallery__image img { object-fit: contain !important; }
  .product-detail__media .media-gallery__image, .product-detail__media .media-gallery__image .loading_image { aspect-ratio: 8 / 5 !important; height: auto !important; padding-top: 0 !important; }
  .product-detail__price .card-product-price { gap: 0 !important; }
  .product-detail__price .price-regular:has(> s), .product-detail__price .price-regular:has(> .compare-price) { display: none !important; }

  .pd-content h3, .pd-content h4, .pd-content h3 ~ *, .pd-content h4 ~ * { display: none !important; }
  .pd-content > p { font-size: 16.5px; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--color-text); max-width: 52ch; }
  .pd-content > p:first-child:has(> strong:only-child) { margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .pd-content > p:first-child > strong:only-child { color: #f0b54a; font-weight: 600; }
  .product-detail__title { font-size: 66px !important; line-height: 1 !important; letter-spacing: -.015em; margin: 18px 0 18px !important; }
  @media (max-width: 749px) { .product-detail__title { font-size: 42px !important; } }
  .product-detail__information { display: flex !important; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; column-gap: 28px; }
  .product-detail__information > .pib-own > * { flex: 0 0 100%; min-width: 0; order: 2; }
  .product-detail__information > .pib-own > *:empty { display: none !important; }
  .product-detail__information > .pib-own > motion-element { order: 0; }
  .product-detail__information > .pib-own > .pd-block { order: 1; }
  .product-detail__information > .pib-own > .product-detail__price { flex: 0 0 auto; order: 3; }
  .product-detail__information > .pib-own > .product-detail__buy-buttons { flex: 0 0 auto; order: 4; }
  .product-detail__information > .pib-own > .mb-25 { order: 5; }
  .product-detail__information > .pib-own > .pib-own, .product-detail__information > .pib-own > .vb { order: 6; }
  .product-detail__price { margin: 6px 0 0 !important; }
  .product-detail__price .price { font-family: var(--heading-font) !important; font-size: 40px !important; line-height: 1 !important; color: var(--color-heading) !important; font-weight: 400 !important; }
  .product-detail__price s, .product-detail__price .compare-price { display: none; }
  .product-detail__text-content { margin: 4px 0 0 !important; font-size: 13px; color: var(--color-text); }
  .product-detail__text-content p { margin: 0; }
  .pib-own:has(.product-detail__text-content) .mb-25 { margin-bottom: 0 !important; }
  .product-detail__buy-buttons { margin: 0 !important; }
  .product-detail__buy-buttons .button, .product-detail__buy-buttons button[type=submit] { width: auto !important; min-width: 0 !important; padding-inline: 26px !important; }
  .vb { margin-top: 22px; }
  .vb svg { color: #f0b54a !important; stroke: #f0b54a; }
  .vb__inner { font-size: 14px; }
}
body.product .section-text-columns {
  .r7t__inner, .tc__inner { border-top: 1px solid rgba(28, 28, 26, .1); padding-top: 36px; }
  h3 { position: relative; padding-left: 28px; font-family: var(--body-font) !important; font-weight: 600 !important; font-size: 15.5px !important; }
  h3::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 3px; top: .12em; width: 7px; height: 13px; border: solid #2f5d50; border-width: 0 2.5px 2.5px 0; rotate: 40deg; }
  p { padding-left: 28px; font-size: 14.5px; }
}
.product-item__information { display: grid !important; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; column-gap: 12px; align-items: baseline; }
.product-item__name { grid-column: 1; font-family: var(--body-font) !important; font-weight: 700 !important; font-size: 15.5px !important; color: var(--color-heading); }
.product-item__price { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; margin: 0 !important; }
.product-item__price .price { font-family: var(--heading-font) !important; font-weight: 400 !important; font-size: 18px !important; color: #2f5d50 !important; }
.product-item__price s { font-size: 13px; }
.product-item__short-description { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin: 6px 0 0 !important; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--color-text); }
.product__media { border-radius: 8px !important; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(28, 28, 26, .08); }
.section-header {
  @media (min-width: 1025px) { .header-middle .header__menu { grid-column: 2 / -1 !important; display: flex !important; justify-content: flex-end !important; } .header-middle .header__action { display: none !important; } .header__menu .horizontal-list { justify-content: flex-end !important; } .header__menu .level0 > .menu-item { padding-inline: 14px !important; } .header__menu .level0:last-child > .menu-item { padding-right: 0 !important; } }
  .header__logo-text { font-size: 26px !important; letter-spacing: -.005em !important; }
  .header { border-bottom-color: rgba(28, 28, 26, .1); }
}
footer.footer {
  .footer__middle { padding-top: 0 !important; padding-bottom: 0 !important; }
  .footer__block-heading { display: none !important; }
  .footer-acc__panel, .footer-acc__inner, .footer-block.collapsible-content { display: block !important; height: auto !important; max-height: none !important; visibility: visible !important; opacity: 1 !important; overflow: visible !important; grid-template-rows: 1fr !important; }
  .footer-block.link_list { border: 0 !important; margin: 0 !important; }
  .footer-block .list-unstyled { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 22px; justify-content: flex-start; margin: 0; padding: 22px 0 18px; }
  @media (min-width: 750px) { .footer-block .list-unstyled { justify-content: flex-end; padding-bottom: 22px; } }
  .footer-block .list-unstyled li { padding: 0 !important; }
  .footer-block .list-unstyled a { font-size: 13.5px; text-decoration: underline !important; text-underline-offset: 3px; text-decoration-color: rgba(233, 231, 224, .45); }
  .footer-block .list-unstyled a:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; }
  .footer-bottom { border-top-color: rgba(233, 231, 224, .14) !important; }
  .footer__copyright, .footer-bottom__legal { font-size: 13px; }

}
</style>
